newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures weaker in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly lower in the after-hours trade on Friday, pressured by active long-liquidation in distant months, traders said.
Prices ranged from unchanged to 0.8 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark March was 0.8 yen weaker at 134.2 yen. Volume was thin with 4,692 lots traded.
During the day, rubber prices shed early gains as technical buying lost steam later in the day. They ended mixed.
Traders said sentiment was mixed, but they agreed further gains could be limited unless there were fresh incentives.
